LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_FrontierPistol.description: An ornate variant of a commonplace Old World pistol, effective at short and medium ranges.\n\nTales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.

LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_RepeatingShotgun.description: An ornate and surprisingly portable shotgun meant to be fired one handed from a mounted position. Packs a punch, earning the title "boomalope leg".\n\nTales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.

LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_RollingBlockRifle.description: An ornate high-power marksmen rifle originally designed for dispatching muffalo in a single shot. Once outfitted with a long-range scope and modernized reloading system it didn't take long for would-be bounty hunters to embrace the hunting instrument.\n\nTales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_RollingBlockRifle.label: rolling block rifle
LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_VolcanicPistol.description: An ornate pistol meant to provide the strength of a full-sized rifle with the portability of a revolver. Surprisingly high ammo capacity and range at the cost of a long time to reload and rather poor accuracy due to recoil.\n\nTales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
